units.source_text: 木村伊兵卫说要拍张照片向海外介绍，所以又让两位棋手摆出对弈的姿势。

en.t: Kimura Ihei said he wanted to take a photograph to introduce the scene overseas, so the two players were once again made to pose as if they were playing a match.

units.source_text: 拍摄完毕，满座的人都如释重负，放松下来。

en.t: When the photography was finished, everyone in the room seemed relieved and relaxed.

units.source_text: 长老七段们也走近棋盘，围观这一盘棋。

en.t: The elder seventh-dan players also came over to the board and gathered around to watch the game.

units.source_text: 有的说白子厚三分六厘，有的说八厘，也有的说九厘，众说纷纭。

en.t: Some said White was ahead by three points and six rin, others said eight rin, and still others said nine rin; opinions were all over the place.

units.source_text: 正在这时，将棋名人木村从旁插话说：

en.t: Just then, Kimura, the shogi master, spoke up from the side:
